description: PAID ($0.01). Use when mail lands in spam, before an email campaign, for vendor due diligence or to confirm a Microsoft 365 tenant: graded SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS, DNSSEC, CAA, TLS and domain age, each with the exact fix record. Non-intrusive. $0.01 per domain. Returns a 0-100 score and, per check (spf, dkim, dmarc, mx, tls = website certificate, m365, registration, mta_sts, tls_rpt, dnssec, caa, bimi), a pass/warn/fail/info grade, the finding and the exact record or step that fixes it. Info checks do not move the score. Invalid, nonexistent or private-only domains are refused free. Pass api_key if you have one (card checkout at /pricing); otherwise the result is the x402 payment requirement.

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

domain.description: Domain or hostname, e.g. example.com (no URL, no IP)

name: domain_check

outputSchema.description: Finished-job dossier: verdict or summary, line items, evidence with official sources. On 402 the x402 PaymentRequired object (isError)

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card
